apps.localizedDescription:
Foxlations:

A manga, manhwa, light-novel and video reader for Android and iOS with an extension-based source system. Add source and/or local repositories, sync progress to AniList / MyAnimeList / Kitsu, back up and restore your library.

Please note that I do school and work full time, so updates might be slow. I do see your messages and issues, it just might take me a bit to get to them!

Foxlations is a reader only. It does not host any content. You add your own sources.

lillq.me/foxlations. Same builds either way:

• foxlations--arm64.apk (Android).
• foxlations-.ipa (iOS, unsigned, for sideloading).

iOS users can add the page's AltStore/SideStore source instead and get updates automatically. The in-app About → Check for Updates reads the same manifest.

versions.localizedDescription:
A big one — light-novel fixes, a Browse overhaul, and a lot of library polish.

Light novels & sources.

• Light-novel (LNReader) sources: fixed a crash when opening some sources, fixed a batch of sources that silently showed nothing, and every request now goes through the Cloudflare-aware path — so more sources load, and a blocked one shows an "Open in WebView" solve button instead of an empty screen.
• When a source fails it now tells you why — Cloudflare, site unreachable, or "needs an update" — instead of a blank "nothing found". Full details stay in More → Debug logs.
• Local sources you build in RepoForge now show up in the Browse repository filter.

Browse.

• Language filter overhaul: the same language is no longer listed twice when repos spell it differently ("English" and "en" now merge), languages show full names, and the picker is a searchable grid where you can pin the ones you use. Filtering by a repository hides languages that repo doesn't have.
• The Repository filter now matches the Language filter, and the Manga / Anime / Novel switch is one consistent control (with a sliding highlight) across Browse, Search and Discover. Pinned sources stay in sync everywhere.

Library.

• Library cards are now yours to arrange (library options → Display): put the title on the cover, below it, or hidden; place the badges in a bar under the cover, in the corner, or stacked on the cover bottom; and show reading progress as a thin line, a mini bar, or a % badge. Local sources get a folder badge, with a legend that explains each badge.
• Filter / Sort / Display was restyled to match the app, and filters are now tri-state: tap once to show only those, again to hide them, again to clear.
• Library updates show new chapters on each title the moment they're found instead of only when the whole check finishes; the Updates tab refreshes when you open it; and a redundant spinner in the header is gone.
• "Chapters read" and "Most-read series" now count your actual read chapters — including ones imported or marked read by hand — so they match the unread badge, streak and heatmap.
• New: a Default category so new titles file themselves automatically (Settings → Library).

Reader & chapters.

• Reader and light-novel settings use the app's sliding pill controls.

Discover.

• The genre filter is now a single "Genres" pill that expands in place, instead of a permanent strip of chips.

Security.

• App lock gained a "Lock after" timeout so a quick app-switch no longer forces you to re-authenticate (Settings → Security). Removed two toggles that weren't wired up yet.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Foxlations uses the camera when a website asks you to take a photo, and, only if you turn on hands-free scrolling, to track your face for gaze-based page scrolling. Face-tracking happens entirely on your device and is never recorded or sent anywhere.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Foxlations uses Face ID to unlock the app when App Lock is turned on.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Foxlations connects to a translation server running on your local network.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Foxlations needs microphone access when a website asks to record audio.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Foxlations needs permission to save manga pages and exported files to your photo library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Foxlations needs photo access to import images you choose.
